subject: Syllogisms
question: Statements: All cats are animals. All animals are living beings. Conclusions: I. All cats are living beings. II. Some living beings are cats. Which conclusion(s) follow?
explanation: All cats are animals and all animals are living beings, so all cats are living beings (I follows). Since all cats are living beings, some living beings are cats (II follows).
